name: Audio Transcription
description: Optional provider setup for transcribing audio files and legacy video workflows.
longDescription: Choose a transcription provider for audio files and optional legacy media workflows. Keep costs under control by using Local Whisper when your computer can run it, or bring a key from the provider you prefer.
author: Larkup

configSchema.label: Audio Provider
configSchema.help: Choose the provider that should transcribe both audio files and video audio tracks.

options.label: Local Whisper
options.description: Runs transcription locally and does not need an API key.

configSchema.label: Baseline coverage interval (seconds)
configSchema.help: A maximum gap for cheap coverage anchors. Activity and scene-change triggers automatically add denser evidence; this is not a fixed sampling rate.

configSchema.label: Provider API key
configSchema.help: Required for the selected provider. This key is used only by the Video & Audio tool.

configSchema.label: Transcription language
configSchema.help: Use auto for provider language detection, or enter a language code such as ar, ar-EG, en, or de to override it.

configSchema.label: Maximum video duration (seconds)
configSchema.help: Reject videos longer than this duration (default: 4 hours / 14400 seconds). Set 0 for no limit.

configSchema.label: Knowledge chunk duration (seconds)
configSchema.help: Maximum timeline chunk processed at once. Overlap and checkpointing keep long videos resumable.

configSchema.label: Maximum retained frames
configSchema.help: Hard cap for retained visual evidence. The information-gain policy may retain fewer frames.

configSchema.label: OCR languages
configSchema.help: Comma-separated OCR language hints; use auto when the configured OCR adapter detects language.

configSchema.label: Maximum per-query inspection spend (USD)
configSchema.help: Hard budget for bounded query-time source inspection; larger work requires a background refinement approval.

configSchema.label: Video Knowledge Engine
configSchema.help: Enable evidence-first video knowledge revisions. Disable only to roll back to the compatible legacy media pipeline.
